title: Repair Linux CPU frozen-reference correctness
scope: Adjudicate and repair the F8-85 Linux Slang CPU result in which all 12 applicable rigid public cases execute but produce 1,582 retained frozen-reference differences including numerical state and invariant failures. Determine whether each divergence is a runtime defect, shared-kernel defect or independently justified oracle defect; never replace a golden merely to match current output. Preserve candidate-v10 as immutable failed evidence.
acceptance: Reproduce all 12 public-case failures from the installed API 0.3 CPU runtime with exact source, package and host identities and separate plain and validation captures.

Use independent analytic invariants and cross-backend traces to identify the first material divergence. Any oracle correction requires a reviewed physical rationale and must continue to reject injected defects.
Pass all applicable public cases within existing tolerances, analytic quality, lifecycle/recovery, rejected-step atomicity, fixed-work and repeatability checks without changing the one-step schedule.
Pass the Linux CPU SDK relocation, Gallery lifecycle, long-run workload and negative-control suites. Retain all performance samples while treating timing separately from correctness.
Publish reviewable exact-source evidence and the complete before/after difference inventory.
